meta.name: Score and log scraped B2B leads with Apify, OpenAI, and Google Sheets

name: Qualify scraped leads with OpenAI and log them to Google Sheets

parameters.content:
## Qualify scraped leads with OpenAI and log them to Google Sheets

### Who's it for
Sales teams, agencies and freelancers who already pull leads from somewhere and want them
scored before a human looks at them. If you spend the first hour of the day deciding which
new leads are worth contacting, this does that part for you.

### What it does
Every morning it pulls a fresh batch of leads from any Apify scraper, normalises the fields,
asks an AI to score each lead from 1-10 against your own ideal-customer profile with a short
reason, and appends every result to a Google Sheet. Low scores are logged too, so you can
tune the profile instead of guessing.

### How to set up
1. Create two Header Auth credentials and select them on the two HTTP nodes.
2. Open "Your settings (EDIT ME)" and describe your ideal customer in plain language.
   Be specific; vague profiles produce vague scores.
3. In "Fetch fresh leads", replace YOUR-USERNAME~YOUR-ACTOR with any Apify actor.
4. Connect Google Sheets and point it at a sheet with the header row listed below.

### Requirements
An n8n instance, an Apify account for the lead source, an OpenAI-compatible API key, and a
Google account. A run costs roughly a cent or two at the default settings.

### How to customize
Swap the actor to change lead source. Edit the system prompt in the AI node to change how
strictly leads are judged. Raise or lower maxLeadsPerRun to control cost per run. The AI
node is a plain HTTP request, so it works with any OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

Sheet header row (exact):
processedAt leadType state businessName ownerName address city county zip eventDate
sourceUrl score reason scoreThreshold

## 1. Credentials (2 required)

**Apify token (Header Auth):** Credentials -> New -> Header Auth.
Name: `Authorization` — Value: `Bearer apify_api_YOUR_TOKEN`

**OpenAI (Header Auth):** Credentials -> New -> Header Auth.
Name: `Authorization` — Value: `Bearer sk-YOUR_KEY`

Then open the two HTTP nodes and select these credentials.
Also connect **Google Sheets** (OAuth) on its node.

## 2. Your settings

Open **"Your settings (EDIT ME)"** and describe:
- your ideal customer profile, in plain words
- max leads per run (this is your cost control)

Be specific about the ICP. "Independent restaurants opening in Texas metros, not chains"
produces far better scores than "restaurants".

The AI scores every lead 1-10 against YOUR words here and writes a one-line reason.

## ③ Lead source (any Apify actor)

The **Fetch fresh leads** node calls Apify's *run-sync-get-dataset-items* endpoint.

Replace `YOUR-USERNAME~YOUR-ACTOR` in the URL with any actor, e.g. a Google Maps scraper, or the demo source:
`rook-data-tools~new-liquor-license-leads`

The JSON body is the actor's input — match it to your chosen actor.

assignments.name: icpDescription
assignments.value: EDIT ME: e.g. Independent restaurants and bars opening soon in Texas metro areas — decision-maker reachable, not a chain, not a temporary event permit.

assignments.name: offerDescription
assignments.value: EDIT ME: e.g. We sell point-of-sale systems for new restaurants — free setup before opening day.
